visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame is split horizontally. In the bottom half, a woman with short black hair and a decorative floral hairpiece wears a blue and purple traditional-style top and pants, seated at a black grand piano against a background of vertical purple fabric curtains. In the top half, an animated sequence begins showing three female characters standing in a neon-lit, futuristic corridor. (2) The woman's hands move fluidly across the piano keys. Above her, the animation shifts rapidly through action sequences: characters wielding a large curved blade, a staff, and glowing daggers engage in combat with stylized monstrous figures in dark environments. (3) The pianist continues her performance with high intensity. The animation above shows the three main characters standing triumphantly, followed by close-up shots of three distinct instant noodle cups labeled MIRA, RUMI, and ZOEY. (4) The woman concludes the piece with a final flourish of her hands. The animation shows the three girls eating from the noodle cups with exaggerated expressions of enjoyment and surprise as their eyes widen.

The rhythm is driven by a steady left-hand bass pattern and complex right-hand melodic runs. (2) The musical intensity remains consistent as the melody goes through several variations, maintaining a high spectral brightness and clear harmonic purity. (3) The piece builds toward a climax with faster arpeggios and rhythmic chords, finally ending on a resonant, sustained major chord with no background noise interference.
